chapter: The Famous Door, Billy May and the Palomar fire
title: Buying new instruments and trying them at Carlos Gastell's Domar Ballroom
summary: The band bought new instruments and rehearsed at the Domar Ballroom run by Carlos Gastell.

story.theme_name: Going west: California and the Los Angeles scene
story.community_name: Going west: moving to and working in California

blocks.x: We all went out and bought new instruments. And there was a guy by the name of Carlos Gastell, who was running -- later he was the manager of Nat Cole and Peggy Lee and Mel Torme and Nellie Lutcher and all that.

And Carlos, that's the first time I met him, he was running a ballroom called the Domar Ballroom, down at one of the beaches, Hermosa or someplace right there, and we had to find a place to play, to try out our new instruments and to find out how much we remembered. He said, 'I'll take the band.' So he put us in there and we went through, and I said, 'Hey, we've got enough. We can go. We don't have to worry about anything.' And of course Carlos and I later became real great friends. In fact we were in business together for a short time. One time I decided I wanted out of the music business and went to work with him as a personal manager.
